title: “Many will try to enter… few will succeed.”
paragraphs: “Many will try to enter… few will succeed.”

Jesus never said the path to life would be popular.
He said it would be narrow.
“Strive to enter through the narrow door. For many, I tell you, will seek to enter and will not be able.”

Many want heaven.
Few want repentance.

Many want salvation.
Few want surrender.

The narrow door requires something the world hates:
humility, obedience, and turning away from sin.

You can’t carry pride through it.
You can’t carry hypocrisy through it.
You can’t carry your old life through it.
The door is narrow… because only truth fits through it.

But here is the hope:
The door is still open.

The question is not whether the door exists.
The question is whether we are willing to enter it.
Are you walking the narrow path… or the crowded one?

“Why do you think Jesus said many will try but few will succeed?
What makes the narrow path so difficult today?”
